# Stand-in people

Six low-poly, rigged and animated figures by Quaternius, published as Public Domain (CC0)
on Poly Pizza. They are the stand-ins in a walkable set (`web/viewfinder-cast.js`); only
their Idle and Walk clips are used. Files are unmodified.

| File | Poly Pizza page | Downloaded from |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `man-in-suit.glb` | https://poly.pizza/m/mQnGoME1ez ("Man in Suit") | https://static.poly.pizza/66b57880-bcb0-479a-8d72-5c3e88afaa39.glb |
| `woman-casual.glb` | https://poly.pizza/m/jpKRgGDxhk ("Woman Casual") | https://static.poly.pizza/51d5abdd-bb87-4b8d-9967-21738ffb8437.glb |
| `business-man.glb` | https://poly.pizza/m/JFrLIKqvCH ("Business Man") | https://static.poly.pizza/e599abbe-7d73-488c-9d7e-3ead281e705c.glb |
| `long-sleeves.glb` | https://poly.pizza/m/DLptRuewTn ("Man in Long Sleeves") | https://static.poly.pizza/e6019b9f-aed0-400c-8df4-ce5b648e9b82.glb |
| `woman.glb` | https://poly.pizza/m/9kF7eTDbhO ("Animated Woman") | https://static.poly.pizza/cf08b740-dd48-443e-9fde-6d3d54abf119.glb |
| `man.glb` | https://poly.pizza/m/HMnuH5geEG ("Man") | https://static.poly.pizza/3746be88-6799-4817-929b-6bc067c47caa.glb |

Licence: CC0 1.0 (public domain dedication), as stated on each page on 2026-11-14.
Author: Quaternius, https://quaternius.com/.

Loading needs `GLTFLoader.js`, `BufferGeometryUtils.js` and `SkeletonUtils.js` from three.js 0.180
(MIT), vendored unmodified under `web/vendor/three/addons/`.
